_comment: The 2023 positive-corpus DISCOVERY MANIFEST (roadmap Phase-1 runner shells): CorpusRunnerTests compiles (and, given a sibling .out, runs+compares) every ENABLED program at --std 2023 strict. Programs exercising not-yet-implemented features stay PENDING (the ISO-validation critics' mass-red guard) and are enabled by the wave that lands their feature. The integrity fact asserts every .cob here is listed (enabled or pending) - nothing is silently undiscovered.
